entities.name: System Information Acquisition Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to acquire AS, NAS, and positioning assistance data information. Applies to UEs in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, and RRC_CONNECTED states.

entities.name: Master Information Block
entities.description: Broadcast system information block containing essential physical layer parameters.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: Broadcast system information block containing cell access information and scheduling of other SIBs.

entities.name: System Information Block 2
entities.description: System information block for cell reselection information.

entities.name: System Information Block 3
entities.description: System information block for intra-frequency cell reselection information.

entities.name: System Information Block 4
entities.description: System information block for inter-frequency cell reselection information.

entities.name: System Information Block 5
entities.description: System information block for E-UTRA cell reselection information.

entities.name: System Information Block 11
entities.description: System information block for idle/inactive measurements configuration.

entities.name: System Information Block 12
entities.description: System information block for NR sidelink communication/discovery configuration.

entities.name: System Information Block 13
entities.description: System information block for V2X sidelink communication configuration.

entities.name: System Information Block 14
entities.description: System information block for V2X sidelink communication configuration.

entities.name: System Information Block 16
entities.description: System information block for slice specific cell reselection information.

entities.name: System Information Block 19
entities.description: System information block for satellite access configuration.

entities.name: System Information Block 20
entities.description: System information block for MBS broadcast service configuration.

entities.name: System Information Block 21
entities.description: System information block for MBS broadcast service configuration.

entities.name: Positioning SIB
entities.description: Positioning system information block requested by upper layers.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains some connection context but is not actively communicating.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection to the network.

entities.name: System Information Request
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request system information from the network.

entities.name: System Information Messages
entities.description: Messages containing system information blocks broadcast by the network.
